defaultConfig.targetPortNote: Python+Gunicorn templates typically use 50505; Node/TS may use 3000 or 8080. Match the app's Dockerfile EXPOSE port.

integration.identityNote: Container Apps support user-assigned managed identity. Pass identity resource ID and client ID as env vars to the container.

appSettings.name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
appSettings.description: Managed identity client ID — used by DefaultAzureCredential to pick the right identity

bicepWiring.note: Container Apps get their config via env vars injected in the Bicep template array. Every downstream service endpoint/name must be in this array.

connectsTo.description: Container Apps connect to downstream services via managed identity + injected env vars. The Bicep template's `env` array in the container config is where ALL service endpoints are wired.
connectsTo.wirePattern:
For each downstream service:
1. Provision the service (Cosmos, Redis, OpenAI, etc.)
2. Create RBAC role assignment: service → managedIdentity.principalId
3. Add service endpoint to Container App's env array
4. App code reads env var and uses DefaultAzureCredential(managed_identity_client_id=AZURE_CLIENT_ID)

sdkInitPattern.python:
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential

# DefaultAzureCredential uses AZURE_CLIENT_ID env var to select the user-assigned identity
credential = DefaultAzureCredential(managed_identity_client_id=os.environ.get('AZURE_CLIENT_ID'))
